## F6 Wnt targets (plus ccnd1 cntrl) in situ area for intact and one-eyed
```{r, echo=FALSE}
Wntinsituenuc <-read.csv("/Users/cervenyk/Documents/fish data/Tectum_Hannah_Mate_collaboration/area quantitation_insitus/institu_area one_eyed_quant_with_ccnD1.csv")
View(Wntinsituenuc)
```
#Plot of area quantitation to accompany ISH data
```{r, echo=FALSE}
WntinsituenucSummary <- summarySE(Wntinsituenuc, measurevar="Ratio", groupvars=c("Gene","Innerv"))
WntinsituenucSummary

Wntinsituenuc$Gene<-factor(Wntinsituenuc$Gene,
                         levels=c("axin2", "lef1", "ccnD1"))

TectumF6P2_Wntinsitu_enuc_with_ccnD1 <- ggplot(Wntinsituenuc, aes(x=Innerv, y=Ratio))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA)+
  geom_jitter(color = "black", fill = "gray", pch=21, size = 2, alpha=0.7, width=0.3)+
  facet_wrap(~Gene, strip.position = "top", scales = "free_x", nrow=1)+
  theme(strip.text.x = element_text(face="italic"))+
  xlab("Innervation Status")+
  ylab("Expression Area Ratio [(L-R)/Total]")+
  ylim(-0.09, 0.28)+
  #stat_compare_means(comparisons = list(c("intact", "one-eyed")), method="wilcox.test",label = "p.signif")

geom_pwc(method = "wilcox.test", label = "p.signif")
#p values: axin = 0.00216, lef1 = 0.016, ccnd1 = 0.841

print(TectumF6P2_Wntinsitu_enuc_with_ccnD1)
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
ggsave ("TectumF6P2_Wntinsitu_enuc_withccnD1.png", TectumF6P2_Wntinsitu_enuc_with_ccnD1, path=NULL, 
        scale = 1, width = 13, height = 10, units = "cm", dpi = 300, limitsize = TRUE, bg=NULL)
```

```{r}
#Specify axin2
A2 <- Wntinsituenuc$Gene == "axin2"
Wntinsituenuc[A2,]
#Specify lef1
L2 <- Wntinsituenuc$Gene == "lef1"
Wntinsituenuc[L2,]
#Specify ccnD1
C2 <- Wntinsituenuc$Gene == "ccnD1"
Wntinsituenuc[C2,]
```
```{r}
# axin2
t.test(Ratio ~ Innerv, data = Wntinsituenuc[A2,])
wilcox.test(Ratio ~ Innerv, data = Wntinsituenuc[A2,], exact = FALSE, conf.int = TRUE)

# lef1
t.test(Ratio ~ Innerv, data = Wntinsituenuc[L2,]) 
wilcox.test(Ratio ~ Innerv, data = Wntinsituenuc[L2,], exact = FALSE, conf.int = TRUE)

# ccnD1
t.test(Ratio ~ Innerv, data = Wntinsituenuc[C2,]) 
wilcox.test(Ratio ~ Innerv, data = Wntinsituenuc[C2,], exact = FALSE, conf.int = TRUE)
```

## Plot and stats for qPCR of intact and one-eyed (@24hpf)
```{r, echo=FALSE}
qPCRWnt <-read.csv("/Users/cervenyk/Documents/fish data/Tectum_Hannah_Mate_collaboration/firstpass_figures for tectum paper/Figures 6_7_Wnt tectum figure images/TectumF6P4_WntqPCR_kc.csv")

View(qPCRWnt)
```
### qPCR bar plot
```{r, echo=FALSE}
qPCRWntSummary <- summarySE(qPCRWnt, measurevar="relative_fold_change", groupvars=c("Gene","Innerv"))
qPCRWntSummary
```
```{r, echo=FALSE}
qPCRWnt$Gene<-factor(qPCRWnt$Gene,
                        levels=c("axin2", "lef1", "ccnD1"))

qPCRWnt$Innerv<-factor(qPCRWnt$Innerv,
                       levels=c("intact", "one-eyed"))

qPCRWntSummary$Gene<-factor(qPCRWntSummary$Gene,
                       levels=c("axin2", "lef1", "ccnD1"))

qPCRWntSummary$Innerv<-factor(qPCRWntSummary$Innerv,
                       levels=c("intact", "one-eyed"))
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
TectumF6P3_WntqPCR<- ggplot(qPCRWntSummary, aes(x= Innerv, y= relative_fold_change))+
  geom_bar(stat="identity", aes(fill=Innerv), show.legend=FALSE)+
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("dark gray", "light gray"))+
  facet_wrap(~Gene, strip.position = "top", scales = "free_x")+
  xlab("Innervation Status")+
  ylab("Relative Fold Change")+ 
  geom_errorbar(data=qPCRWntSummary, 
                aes(ymin=relative_fold_change-ci,
                    ymax=relative_fold_change+ci, width=.15))+
  theme(strip.text.x = element_text(face="italic"))+
  ylim(0, 1.67)+
  stat_compare_means(data=qPCRWnt,comparisons = list(c("intact", "one-eyed")), method="t.test", label = "p.signif")
#p values: axin = 0.011, lef1 = 0.14, ccnd1 = 0.31

print(TectumF6P3_WntqPCR)
```
```{r, echo=FALSE}
ggsave ("TectumF6P3_Wnt_targets_qPCR.png", TectumF6P3_WntqPCR, path=NULL, 
        scale = 1, width = 14, height = 10, units = "cm", dpi = 300, limitsize = TRUE, bg=NULL)
```
### Part 3 Statistics
```{r, echo=FALSE}
#Summary Statistics (n, mean, SD)

group_by(qPCRWnt, Innerv, Gene) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(count = n(),
    mean = mean(relative_fold_change, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(relative_fold_change, na.rm = TRUE))
```
```{r, echo=FALSE}
#Specify axin2
A <- qPCRWnt$Gene == "axin2"
qPCRWnt[A,]
#Specify lef1
L <- qPCRWnt$Gene == "lef1"
qPCRWnt[L,]
#Specify ccnD1
C <- qPCRWnt$Gene == "ccnD1"
qPCRWnt[C,]
```
```{r, echo=FALSE}
#Before t-test, you have to (1) check for normal distribution and (2) check for equal variance
# Check for normal distribution
with(qPCRWnt[A,], shapiro.test(relative_fold_change[Innerv == "intact"])) #p-value = 0.499
with(qPCRWnt[A,], shapiro.test(relative_fold_change[Innerv == "one-eyed"])) #p-value = 0.9735
with(qPCRWnt[L,], shapiro.test(relative_fold_change[Innerv == "intact"])) #p-value = 0.5529
with(qPCRWnt[L,], shapiro.test(relative_fold_change[Innerv == "one-eyed"])) #p-value = 0.3103
with(qPCRWnt[C,], shapiro.test(relative_fold_change[Innerv == "intact"])) #p-value = 0.4744
with(qPCRWnt[C,], shapiro.test(relative_fold_change[Innerv == "one-eyed"])) #p-value = 0.3086
#p-value > 0.05 implies that the distribution of the data are not significantly different from normal distribution.
```
```{r, echo=FALSE}
qqnorm(qPCRWnt[A,]$relative_fold_change, pch = 1, frame = FALSE)
qqline(qPCRWnt[A,]$relative_fold_change, col = "steelblue", lwd = 2)
```
```{r, echo=FALSE}
qqnorm(qPCRWnt[L,]$relative_fold_change, pch = 1, frame = FALSE)
qqline(qPCRWnt[L,]$relative_fold_change, col = "steelblue", lwd = 2)
```
```{r, echo=FALSE}
qqnorm(qPCRWnt[C,]$relative_fold_change, pch = 1, frame = FALSE)
qqline(qPCRWnt[C,]$relative_fold_change, col = "steelblue", lwd = 2)
```
```{r, echo=FALSE}
# Variance Testing
var.test(relative_fold_change ~ Innerv, data = qPCRWnt[A,]) #p-value = 0.5313
var.test(relative_fold_change ~ Innerv, data = qPCRWnt[L,]) #p-value = 0.9156
var.test(relative_fold_change ~ Innerv, data = qPCRWnt[C,]) #p-value = 0.005168  *
```
```{r, echo=FALSE}
# T-Test or wilcox.test for comparing 2 variables (go with wilcox since it is more conservative in this instance; unequal variance but equal number of samples)

# axin2
t.test(relative_fold_change ~ Innerv, data = qPCRWnt[A,]) #p-value = 0.01081
wilcox.test(relative_fold_change ~ Innerv, data = qPCRWnt[A,], exact = FALSE, conf.int = TRUE) #p-value = 0.02857

# lef1
t.test(relative_fold_change ~ Innerv, data = qPCRWnt[L,]) #p-value = 0.1367
wilcox.test(relative_fold_change ~ Innerv, data = qPCRWnt[L,], exact = FALSE, conf.int = TRUE) #p-value = 0.1643

# ccnD1
t.test(relative_fold_change ~ Innerv, data = qPCRWnt[C,]) #p-value = 0.3051
wilcox.test(relative_fold_change ~ Innerv, data = qPCRWnt[C,], exact = FALSE, conf.int = TRUE) #p-value = 0.3429
```
